name: Murmurs Of Monsters
source:
Exhausted from a long week, all Nel Foster wants to do is get back to their apartment and go to bed. So what if the fastest way home is through the forest full of dangerous creatures that live among the trees? Those stories were nothing more than rumors meant to scare children into being safe.

The eyes following them home beg to differ. 

[From [url=https://fangsoft.itch.io/murmurs-of-monsters]itch.io[/url]]
